hotel.name: ANVI GRAND
hotel.address: Anvi Grand, near Benz Circle, Eluru Road, Vijayawada

rooms.name: Anvi Executive Red Suite
rooms.description: Signature red-accent suite with king bed, monsoon-ready AC, and a calm work desk. Ideal for business travellers and couples visiting Vijayawada.

rooms.name: Executive Suite
rooms.description: Separate sitting area, premium linen, and an expansive bathroom. Our most requested suite for longer stays and VIP guests.

rooms.name: Family Twin
rooms.description: Twin beds with extra rollaway option, perfect for families exploring Kanaka Durga Temple and the Krishna riverfront.

rooms.name: Grand Presidential
rooms.description: Our signature presidential floor—private dining nook, butler desk, and panoramic Eluru Road views for weddings and corporate hosts.

venues.name: Royal Grand Ballroom
venues.description: Column-free ballroom with stage, LED wall option, and in-house CHIGURU catering.

venues.name: Imperial Ruby Mini Hall
venues.description: Flexible mini hall with DJ-ready sound and soft ruby lighting—ideal for up to 150 guests.

menu.name: CHIGURU Special Handi Biryani
menu.description: Slow-cooked dum biryani finished in a sealed handi—signature CHIGURU main.

menu.name: Gongura Mutton
menu.description: Andhra classic—tangy gongura with slow-cooked mutton.

menu.name: Pesarattu & Upma
menu.description: Crisp green gram dosa with soft upma and ginger chutney.

menu.name: Panasa Pottu Biryani
menu.description: Jackfruit biryani from coastal Andhra kitchens—aromatic and filling.

menu.name: Natu Kodi Pulusu
menu.description: Country chicken curry simmered with garam masala and red chilli.

menu.name: Filter Coffee
menu.description: Strong South Indian filter coffee in steel tumbler service.

buffets.name: Weekend Andhra Buffet
buffets.description: Saturday–Sunday lunch buffet featuring gongura, pulusu, rice stations, and sweets.

buffets.name: Executive Dinner Buffet
buffets.description: Weeknight dinner buffet for walk-ins and in-house guests—veg and non-veg live counters.

facilities.name: Rooftop Pool
facilities.description: Evening swims with city views—open 6 AM to 10 PM.

facilities.name: Wellness Spa
facilities.description: Massage and steam for guests after long road days.

facilities.name: Fitness Centre
facilities.description: Cardio and free weights—24-hour access for in-house guests.

facilities.name: Secure Parking
facilities.description: Valet and self-park near Benz Circle entrance.
